nodes.label: QES Trust Anchors Directory
nodes.rationale: A signer certificate counts as qualified only if its chain closes into one of the root/intermediate anchors here (see src/lib/qesVerify.ts). Fail-closed by design: an empty directory means no signature is accepted (production refuses signing), preventing acceptance of unqualified certificates. Certificate files are operational configuration and never committed; path overridable via QES_TRUST_DIR.

nodes.label: Romanian Qualified Trust Service Providers
nodes.rationale: certSIGN, Transsped, DigiSign, Alfasign - qualified providers per eIDAS / official ANCOM list / EU Trusted List; their qualified roots and intermediates populate the trust-anchor directory.
